end.summary:
Practised position-time and velocity-time graphs through motion stories.
Read v-t graph slope as acceleration; 4/4 unaided responses were correct.
Interpreted graph sections as speeding up, constant velocity, and slowing to rest; 4/4 unaided responses were correct.
Calculated distance from graph area and acceleration from slope in worked examples.
Teach-back was not completed; Ira reported feeling tired near the end.
end.parentNote: Ira practised reading slopes and areas on motion graphs, and explaining each graph as a story of movement. They correctly described changing velocity, constant velocity, stopping, acceleration, and distance calculations using the given methods. There was a brief mix-up about a graph showing terrain; Ira corrected it later by stating that an x-t graph shows position changing with time, not the shape of the road. At home, ask them to explain one x-t and one v-t graph aloud, naming what the slope and area mean.
